attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify System Firewall (T1562.004)
attackers_goals: An attacker may turn the firewall off to exfiltrate data and communicate with C2 servers.
description: The Windows Firewall has been disabled. Malware may turn it off to exfiltrate data and communicate with C2 servers.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Investigate the endpoint to determine if the process is legitimately disabling the firewall.
name: Suspicious disablement of the Windows Firewall
